rachel_sre: Short heads-up: We're running a short eviction-stability check on edge kvcache Tue 2026-05-20 01:30-02:15 UTC. Purpose: validate stage gates and observe eviction tail behavior after config tweak. Affects: us-east-1 and eu-west-1 small subset.
rachel_sre: Plan: enable canary purge (5%) -> observe 10m -> gradual ramp to 25% if stable. Purge criteria: drop prefixes >35d.
opsbot: Event logged: 'eviction-stability-check' Tue 2026-05-20T01:30Z (ops link: https://ops.internal/events/EV-STAB-2026).
matt_oncall: Ack. I'll monitor edge.kvcache.evictions_per_min, infer.latency_p95, route.5xx_pct, and infra.gpu.mem.free.
rachel_sre: Quick ops steps: 1) start canary: `POST /infra-api/route-shift {"policy":"evict-check","percent":5}` 2) watch metrics 10m 3) ramp: `POST ... {"percent":25}` 4) rollback: `POST ... {"percent":0}` and `kubectl scale cronjob kv-evict-check -n infra --replicas=0`.
sam_eng: I'll run soft-rewarm with jitter and cap per-AZ qps 120. Script: `tools/soft_rewarm --workers 4 --qps 120 --jitter 45`. Add logs to runbook.
jane_prod: Product: prepare brief support blurb to send if any Dedicated tenant sees p95 +10% for >20m. We'll wait to send unless threshold crossed.
matt_oncall: Rollback triggers I want in the runbook: infer.p95 > baseline*1.2 for 10m OR 5xx_rate +0.5% abs for 5m. I'll create alert notes.
rachel_sre: Links: runbook https://confluence.internal/infra/eviction-stability-check, dashboards https://grafana.internal/d/kv-evict-check. I'll post updates here during the run. Ping if you want to shadow the canary before 01:15 UTC.
